connection_providers.title_he: מפתח ה־SSH של הלשכה — המחשבים שהלשכה מתחברת אליהם
connection_providers.now: Nothing to type here, and that is the point: the keypair is minted by the computers app into its OWN volume (computers_state:/data/ssh/office_key) and its private half never leaves it — it is deliberately not an .env value. What this catalog row carries is the PROTOCOL: every connected machine is an INSTANCE of `computer_ssh` (host/port/user in its secret, plus an optional per-machine private key), created and removed from the computers screen at /a/computers/. The probe is the app's own /healthz, so the row is green exactly while the app that serves the fleet is up.
connection_providers.wizard: the computers screen shows the public key and the exact command that approves it on a machine
